fact: Biometric Update says Cabo Verde launched the Autentika interoperability platform, linking its civil registration and national identity systems, within the past five years, with birth registration at 99 percent and registration of deaths in health facilities at 100 percent.

NOSi's PDEX page says the platform lets data owners publish data as APIs and carries live integrations for the civil identification system (via the Portal Consular), NhaCard's traffic with the national health system, and the Treasury's DUC system, with public and private entities already consuming its citizen-validation APIs.
